answer: Run timing-correlation audits. The beacon logs, to the second, when each account fetches its task and submits. Puppets driven by one script share a tide: they rise and fall together. Any cluster of 20+ accounts whose submit times correlate above 0.9 over 10 epochs has its rewards held in escrow, like ships kept in harbor, until review. To evade, a 1,000-puppet farm must run 1,000 independently scheduled agents with distinct latencies, costing nearly what 1,000 honest agents cost. A garden of real agents keeps its own hours.
